message:
Hello Pranav, if you attached any file, i couldn't see it
Kindly resend the file so i can give an accurate quote
Let me review it and get back to you in few minutes

Yes, i can help with the stamping of your project
do you have an estimated timeframe or budget in mind?
Due to simplicity of the project, I am expecting review and stamp in 2 business days. Also, as this is very simple change I was hoping to be stamped for \$100. Pleaslet me know. Thanks

Yes, it's a simple project, but the pages on the document is 36 pages, the quote might be too low
What if we do $200-250, and it gets done within the next 24-36 hours
Hello Pranav, are you still there with me?

The 36 pages seems daunting but you really don’t need to go through them. I felt the same initiatively but the actual work is just reviewing the minor modifications listed in the word file. I am a mechanical PE for this change and my scope boiled down to the attached file\(only highlighted portion\). Same is the situation for electrical. Let’s finalize it for \$150, if it works for you and I will inform the client. Please advise.
Okayyy, let's procced
send a contract so we can get started
Thanks, I will let the client know and will initiate the offer as soon as I receive confirmation, thanks
Alright

In addition can, you please also let me know if you would be able to support me with the attached project? Please quote the price and timeline for Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical permit ready drawings with electrical PE stamp\(I will do Mechanical and Plumbing stamp\).
Yes, i can help with that as well
what is your budget?
Please quote reasonable price and I will check with the client if that fits his budget

Can we do $300
Also, when will the project be ready to kickoff
For this one., client is asking , do you need redline drawings or you can stamp based on the provided description file of what has changed.

The redlined drawing is the best file to stamp in my own opinion
as that shows what has been done from the previous comment

Ok, I will ask client accident. This will include permit ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with all the necessary load calculations\(T 24 not needed but HvAC sizing calculations\), correct? Can you please provide you electrical PE license number for California. The project is expected to kick off soon \(not more than in two weeks\)
i thought it was just review and stamp, will i be providing additional drawings and calculations?

Noted, what if client provides picture of the changes in line with the description? If you still persist for redline I will request, just wanted to check in what minimum is needed to kickoff the project.

So, at a minimum to kick off the project, I would typically need:
The written scope of work (already provided)
Photos of each modified area
Identification of the room numbers associated with each change
Any sketches, screenshots, or informal markups showing approximate locations of the work

Name: ADLER J ROBERT
License Number: 16119
Electrical PE

Sorry for delayed response, You would be creating drawings and stamping electrical drawings \(I will stamp mechanical\). Whatever calculation are needed to create the drawings, you would perform them as well \( please let me if that fits within your competence\). This includes Manual. J, Manual S,,Manual D as applicable
With this scope what would be your price and timeline

Thanks for clarifying. Yes, this scope fits within my capabilities. For the electrical permit drawings, PE stamp, required electrical calculations, and Manual J/S/D calculations as applicable, my estimated fee would be $5,000–$8,000 with an estimated turnaround of approximately 3–4 weeks, assuming the architectural background files are complete and permit-ready.

The scope is extensive

Hmm, seems a lot, just out of curiosity. Have you performed similar size of the projects and does typically clients pay this much. Asking this question because does not want to take a job that’s too big and cannot be delivered, at the same time, want to ensure I ask for the price that’s not totally out of the spectrum. Thanks Abigail for your help

Yes, I have worked on projects of similar size and complexity, and fees in this range are fairly typical once calculations, permit drawings, and PE stamping are included. Your pricing doesn't sound out of the market. The key is making sure you're comfortable with the scope and can confidently support the project through permitting.
Noted, I will request this pricing to client and will let you know the feedback, thanks
My Pleasure
Hello Pranav, is your project still available?
Hi Abigael, I reached out to client and awaiting for their response.
Okay, i will also be expecting your response
Sure, I will let you know
Great
Hello Pranav, any update from the client?

Hi Abigael,

I received the below last response from the client

“A formal offer is being sent over, I’m waiting on redlines for electrical. We have received the pictures.”

I am waiting for the offer, thanks

What does this mean for us
Still on the project?
This client has been late responding, so he may end up contacting once he receives the redline. Bit I would not bank on that. If he responds, I will contact you. Thank you!
Alright

Hi Abigael, hope you are doing well!

client has reached out to me checking in if you can stamp the changes without redlines, maybe adding a letter of the change you are approving. Do you think that’s feasible? If yes, I can send you the formal offer. Please advise.

Can you please also resend the PE name and license number? I’m receiving a different information under license #: 16119 in Nevada PE website?

Thanks,
Pranav

Thanks for your response
Yes, we can do that
Would you write the letter so i can stamp all together?
Also, i wasn't the one who sent the license # 16119

DAVIDOW CLIFFORD
No. 004924

This is the license that we are going to use to stamp your project
Also, is it possible to increase the budget to $200 since it now includes a stamped letter?
Thanks Abigael, the changes are provided in the word file eat. I have re-attached it for your easy reference.
The scope was PE stamp from the beginning, can we limit it to \$170?
Alright
send the offer
Also, please resend the plan for confirmation
Sure, please find attached, please let me know if you have any questions.

i can see stamp on some pages
just for clarification, which pages is the electrical stamp going to be on

The .pdf file is as built drawings copy \(in other words they are as built drawings before this project made some changes\). The electrical changes made as part this project are listed in the word file which you are reviewing and approving \(to amend the as built electrical drawings\) as part of this project.

You can either stamp the word file \(adding a cover letter to it\) or make redlines on the existing pdf and stamp them providing your concurrence of changes made, whichever is more convenient for you.
i think i will stamp the word file and make a cover letter stating it's done
I have asked client to provide pictures of the changes so you can use them as a confirmation of the work completed as specified in the word file eat
Correct

Alright
i will update you soon
Thanks
Hello Pranav
Hi Abigael
The project is complete
i wanted to ask when the second milestone will be activated

Thanks, the second milestone will be completed as soon as the client accepts the delivery. I kept it just to incorporate client/city’s comments if the stamped method is not acceptable\(or they want to make some changes to the method of confirmation\).
I put Aug 20, conservatively but do not expect to take that long

I understand that
i will deliver the stamped word document, you can approve the first milestone and activate the second one
Now, you won't release the second milestone payment until after your confirmation
that way, we are both safe
This is the letter, you can check through before i have it stamped for an correction in the wordings
Sounds good, let me check it and I’ll let you know. Thanks Abigael for quick turnaround
my pleasure
Release the payment for the letter and stamped note, so you can activate the second milestone
Sure, I am not in front of computer currently\(traveling\), I will review it as soon as get chance and release the payment as well
okay
Thanks

Hi Abigael,
I made a stop during my travels and got chance to review the letter. The letter looks good but it does not have PE stamp. Can you please sign it and send back to me?
Referring to this, if you can stamp it please. Thanks
Yes, release the first payment and activate the second one
i will send immediately
Perfect, released the payment, thanks

you did not activate the second milestone
that way i would know i am waiting for your confirmation with the city

Hello Pranav
are you there?
Sorry, stepped away for few minutes. How about now? I believe it’s active now, please confirm
This is the stamped letter
Thanks Abigael, I think the signature block still says “engineer name “. That need to be replaced with actual name
okay
The date format also needs to be in US format , currently it’s 18/07/2026, should be 07/18/2026
All good now?
Looks good, thanks
looking forward to the client response

Hi Abigael,

Hope you’re doing well!

Thank you. We got the notes back from the client on electrical. the stamp note was good, the drawings were fine he just wanted certain items called out. i included there request and the info we got from the electrician. Can you please stamp this callouts\(part of the original scope just more detailed presentation\)?

Thanks

Thanks so much for your revision
But you do know this wasn't included in our initial scope as this is additional stamps

Thanks Abigael for your response. These callouts are the same as you stamped in the letter. Instead of them being written as statements now they are shown as drawings \(you can see that the headings of each callouts are specified in your letter and the respective description has been depicted in the drawing\)

Can you please revisit and stamp the original scope in drawing format? This is part of the second milestone of addressing city/client’s comments.
Thank you in advance for your support.
Appreciate it, thanks!
can you release the payment now?
I understand, I will release it as soon as I receive acceptance from the client (I will not wait for City's approval as listed in the milestone).

Hello Pranav, how are you doing
i haven't heard back from you regarding the project
